scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.build:production: VITE_SITE_ENV=production npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.checkout-link: npm run build --workspace server && node --env-file=.env scripts/checkout-link.mjs
scripts.stripe:check: npm run build --workspace server && node --env-file=.env scripts/stripe-check.mjs
